evidence: TickerLayer's official Stocks page describes U.S. and international equities as derived, non-exchange-sourced feeds.
Its official site says inputs are non-exchange-sourced, including OTC activity, peer-to-peer activity, contributor pricing, and CFD-style pricing references, with no direct venue connectivity.
TickerLayer benchmarks U.S. names against the NBBO and reports overlap/within-basis-point metrics; benchmark similarity is not National NBBO lineage.
Free tier provides REST request allowance, but strict G9 fails before entitlement analysis because the feed is explicitly not official exchange/consolidated SIP data.
reopen_condition: Only reopen if TickerLayer replaces the derived/non-exchange U.S. stock feed with primary-source documented consolidated CTA/UTP SIP National NBBO lineage for the exact API product.
